info.name: King's Lab API
info.description:
Complete API collection for King's Lab backend - AI & Deep Learning Research Lab

This collection includes all endpoints for:
- Authentication
- Research Areas
- Publications
- Team Members
- Lab Information
- Hero Sections
- Contact Information
- Timeline Events
- Contact Submissions
- Dashboard Analytics

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create an environment with variables: `base_url`, `auth_token`
3. Set `base_url` to your API URL (e.g., http://localhost:5000)
4. Login first to get the auth token (automatically saved)
5. All authenticated requests will use the saved token

## Authentication:
Most POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE requests require authentication.
The auth token is automatically saved after login.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register a new admin user. Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.
Login with email and password. Returns JWT token that is automatically saved to environment.
Get currently authenticated user information.
Update user password. Requires current password.
Refresh expired JWT token using refresh token.
Logout current user and invalidate token.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user login, registration, and token management.
